youtube.title: Who drinks the most tea per person? Not Britain 🫖
youtube.description:
The nation famous for its afternoon cup, the country that grew the leaf first, or the third one? One of them drinks more than three kilos of tea per person every year, almost all of it grown on its own wet hills, and serves it dozens of times a day in small curved glasses.
Which did you pick?
